Hi, I’m experiencing the same issue, it seems. I am using: * [product_name] V5.0.21 * Java V6 update 3 * Windows XP Professional SP2 The attached files might help solve this, including screenshots and a text file with the error messages.

Could you try connecting your PC to your device and uploading the code from the device to [product_name]? You might be able to save it again without encountering the error.

analysis.insight_summary: Several users faced project file corruption issues while working with [product_name] V5, resulting in an inability to reopen files after changes. Error messages were reported regardless of minor software version differences, indicating potential issues with Java integration or file saving, which caused workflow interruptions and forced users to recreate their projects.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to reliably save and reopen project files without risking data loss during typical modifications or interface operations.
